## 2. Executive Summary
Systems Engineer and Full Stack & Backend Software Engineer with 5+ years of real production experience building, modernizing, and scaling digital products for startups and technology companies. Works across backend engineering (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, LoopBack 4, Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, Ktor), web/mobile frontend (React, Next.js, Angular, Astro), cloud infrastructure (AWS ECS/ECR/EC2/S3/Load Balancer/API Gateway/SQS/SNS, Google Cloud Functions, Cloudflare, Docker), product analytics, and internal AI tooling.

Collaborates directly with stakeholders across product, operations, support, and finance to deliver end-to-end solutions: technical design (Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, Spec-Driven Development), unit testing and AI-powered E2E testing, database migrations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), caching, distributed locks, throttling, and job queues with Redis/BullMQ, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and production observability with Datadog. Automates manual internal team workflows using Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG, area-specific AI skills/plugins, and Cloudflare AI Gateway, and iterates with CleverTap and Metabase metrics.

## 3. Professional Experience

### GoodRec · Semi Senior Full Stack Engineer / Backend Engineer
- **Period:** January 2025 – Present
- **Modality:** Remote
- **Key Responsibilities & Achievements:**
  - Led the migration of a legacy application and unstructured Firebase Realtime Database into a normalized PostgreSQL database and renewed NestJS/TypeScript stack, accelerated through AI-assisted workflows and Spec-Driven Development.
  - Evolved from pure Backend to end-to-end Full Stack (web, mobile, backend, and cloud infrastructure), working directly with stakeholders on retention, growth, and UX solutions validated with CleverTap and Metabase.
  - Designed and maintained a real-time chat microservice; implemented general-purpose fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging with AWS SQS & SNS, caching, distributed locks, throttling/rate limiting, and job queues with Redis & BullMQ, plus Stripe payments and Firebase Remote Config.
  - Managed deployments and cloud infrastructure on AWS (ECS, ECR, EC2, S3, Load Balancer, API Gateway), GCP (Cloud Functions), Cloudflare, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD, with unit testing, AI-powered E2E tests, and Datadog observability.
